rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[4rem] font-extrabold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]
rules.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

typography.instruction: Avoid Inter for headings. Keep Plus Jakarta Sans for a clean, modern fintech feel. Rely on radical weight contrast (e.g., Extrabold headings vs Regular body). Use 'tracking-tighter' on large headings.

rules.contrast: Always verify APCA contrast. Ensure text over primary buttons is pure white. Dark mode backgrounds should avoid pure black; use the provided Deep Navy.
rules.accents: Limit primary/electric blue for primary actions. Use soft gray for section backgrounds to create rhythm.

surfaces.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-[#0B1736]/70 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10
surfaces.cards: bg-white dark:bg-[#122045] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl
surfaces.floating_ui: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md dark:bg-[#122045]/90 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xl rounded-xl

visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders to define grid edges, especially in the dashboard. Avoid heavy box shadows in admin panels.

marketing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-20 to py-32 for sections. Container px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
marketing.hero: Two-column grid (md:grid-cols-2). Left: Text & CTA. Right: Photorealistic image with absolute positioned floating UI cards (invoice, amount, QRIS DEMO, status).
marketing.features: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Mix tall and wide cards.
marketing.timeline: 7-step 'How it works'. Vertical line with nodes on left, content on right. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered reveals.

dashboard.sidebar: Fixed width (e.g., 260px), border-r, compact vertical navigation.
dashboard.content: Dense, highly structured. Standard spacing (p-6). Use strict grid hierarchy for metric summary cards (grid-cols-4) and charts.
dashboard.tables: Full width, subtle borders, compact padding.

rules.hover: Subtle translations (-translate-y-1) and shadow increases on cards.
rules.buttons: Scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95) for tactile feedback.
rules.scroll: Staggered fade-up for marketing sections. Use react-intersection-observer or framer-motion whileInView.
rules.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out', except when using specific transform properties.

hero_scanning.description: Indonesian customer scanning a QRIS stand in a café, used as the right-side base image in the two-column hero.

dashboard_preview.description: Abstract illustrative dashboard data visualization for the 'Dashboard Showcase' section.

media.rules: Ensure all hero images have overlay to guarantee text readability if text is on top, but right-side column images don't need heavy overlays, just subtle shadow under floating UI.

accessibility.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Support keyboard navigation. Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Contrast ratios must comply with APCA guidelines.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing strictly on the 'hybrid_fullstack' requirement: The marketing site is visually striking and spacious; the dashboard is dense, clean, and functional.
Do not use generic center-aligned marketing headers without intentional typography tension. Left-align text for better flow where applicable.

Marketing Hero: Create a right-column container for the image. Overlay custom floating UI components (use absolute positioning, backdrop-blur, slight rotation/transform) representing 'Invoice, Amount, QRIS DEMO, Status'.
Bento Features: 8 feature cards. Add a 'Segera Hadir' (Coming Soon) Badge to a few cards.
Timeline: Build a 7-step vertical timeline. Use simple glowing nodes.
Use Shadcn UI for complex dashboard forms/tables, but heavily customize to match the 'Deep Navy' & 'Electric Blue' premium feel.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on forms like login, register, reset-password.
Use React Router (or equivalent) structure with distinct layouts for Marketing, Auth, Dashboard, Admin, and Public Payment Page.
Payment page (/pay/:invoiceId): Include a mockup QR code, Payable Amount, Countdown timer, and animated Success/Pending Status.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' outputs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not center align the entire App container.
Use 2-3x more spacing in marketing pages than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL interactive elements and key text.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
